title: Hurricane Rachel Forecast Discussion Number 21
summary: Issued at 200 AM MST Fri Oct 02 2026 000 WTPZ43 KNHC 020836 TCDEP3 Hurricane Rachel Discussion Number 21 NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL EP182026 200 AM MST Fri Oct 02 2026 Rachel's satellite presentation has degraded somewhat over the past several hours, with the eye becoming obscured in conventional satellite imagery and some mid-level dry air entraining into the northeastern portion of the circulation. However, recent microwave imagery indicates that the inner-core structure remains intact. A 0429 UTC METOP-B scatterometer pass helped refine the wind radii and structure. The latest Dvorak Data-T estimate from TAFB decreased to 4.5/77 kt, with objective intensity estimates ranging from 87 to 104 kt. Given these estimates and the degraded satellite presentation, the initial intensity is lowered to 100 kt. The initial motion is westward, or 270/4 kt, and this motion is expected to continue with a gradual increase in forward speed over the weekend and into early next week as a mid-level ridge builds to the north.
